answer.decision: Regional token buckets with bounded global quotas and local burst allowance.
answer.action: Implement one regional stateful limiter dependency per existing regional deployment pattern, using replicated tenant entitlements to allocate bounded regional quota shares. Add local burst capacity sized for short 4× spikes, enforce per-tenant isolation, fail open only within a strict emergency ceiling during limiter impairment, and asynchronously rebalance regional allocations based on observed demand.
reasons: Regional enforcement avoids adding the 180 ms p99 cross-region control-plane latency to request decisions and prevents a global limiter from becoming a partition-sensitive bottleneck.
Bounded regional allocations cap each tenant's aggregate impact more reliably than uncoordinated per-instance buckets, which can multiply effective quotas as instances scale.
Local burst allowance accommodates frequent sub-20-second spikes reaching 4× the five-minute average, reducing costly false throttling.
Regional independence allows healthy application instances to continue serving during failures like the prior 11-minute regional dependency outage.
The design can use already-replicated entitlement data and requires only one new kind of stateful dependency, fitting the stated operational budget.
Strong tenant isolation is especially important because the top 2 percent of tenants produce 61 percent of peak request volume.
assumptions: Regional quota shares can be configured so their sum does not exceed each tenant's bounded global quota, with controlled temporary burst headroom.
The existing regional operating model can host the same limiter technology in all three regions while counting it as one new stateful dependency type.
Some temporary underutilization or bounded overshoot is acceptable in exchange for partition tolerance and lower false-throttling risk.
risks: Static regional allocations may falsely throttle a tenant whose traffic shifts abruptly between regions; asynchronous rebalancing and reserved burst headroom mitigate this.
Local burst allowances can permit bounded global quota overshoot when several regions burst simultaneously.
The limiter adds stateful operational load to a five-person team and requires careful observability, capacity planning, and failure-mode testing.
Fail-open behavior during impairment could threaten shared capacity unless protected by strict per-tenant and regional emergency ceilings.

citations.claim: The top 2 percent of tenants generate 61 percent of peak-hour request volume.
Bursts frequently reach 4× a tenant's five-minute average for less than 20 seconds.
Cross-region control-plane round trips have p99 latency of 180 ms.
A prior regional dependency outage lasted 11 minutes while regional application instances remained healthy.
The platform team can support at most one new stateful dependency.
Tenant entitlement data is already replicated regionally and can supply quota inputs without a global lookup.
